brief: @buildthis.bisks.net is there already a tool for determining who of your mutuals haven't liked, replied, or reposted any of your posts in the past 60 days? if so there needs to be one
note: Yep, already exists: ghostmoots lists mutuals with no like/reply/repost on your posts in the last 60 days (30/90/180 too), with a one-tap hi. #NaNoFoMo
